nodes.asset_description: Two small bottles with black lids sit inside a white bowl lined with a white, textured cloth. The bowl rests on a marble surface with black veins. The background is a light gray textured wall.
Two dark glass dropper bottles with gold caps and white dropper tips are placed on a yellow and orange background. The bottles are positioned diagonally, with one slightly higher than the other.

A hand is holding a white plastic pump bottle against a light brown background. The bottle has a white pump dispenser and a white body. The hand is positioned with the palm facing the camera and the fingers slightly spread apart. The bottle casts a shadow on the background, indicating a light source from above.

Three cosmetic products are arranged on a light pink surface. On the left is a tube of cream with a white cap. In the center is a larger tube of cream with a white cap. To the right is a clear dropper bottle with a white cap. The background is a solid light pink color.
A white diamond shape is centered on a black background. The diamond is oriented with its point facing slightly upward.
